Review areaWhat to agree

Logo & sampleAgree the artwork, decoration position and approval sample for the selected model.
Order & deliveryConfirm quantity, packing, price, minimum order, schedule and shipping scope in the quote.
01

What affects the minimum order?

An existing shape, a new body colour, multiple logo versions and custom packaging are different production briefs. List quantities per model, colour and artwork rather than only the total order.

02

Compare the same specification

For a small run, compare a simpler logo treatment, standard components and the packaging you actually need. Ask for separate sample and production quotes so the two costs are clear.

BUYER QUESTIONS

Questions before an order.

What is the minimum order quantity for custom cups?

MOQ is quoted for the selected model, decoration, colour and packing. There is no confirmed site-wide minimum. Send the quantity you need, including quantities per design, for a project review.

What should I include in a custom drinkware enquiry?

Send a model or reference, intended use, estimated quantity, artwork, packing, destination and required arrival date. If a specification is undecided, describe the use so it can be reviewed with the model.

Are the reference images and specifications the final order?

Use the references to discuss the project. Confirm the final material, dimensions, components, artwork and sample in the written specification before production.

How is a quote request sent?

Submit the project details and artwork on the contact page. The receiving service confirms storage with an enquiry reference. Email forwarding is pending configuration in this preview; website receipt does not mean an email has been delivered.
